task: Hey, thanks for coming over to the TextWorld today, there is something I need you to do for me. First step, make an effort to take a trip east. And then, venture north. And then, go east. Following that, attempt to go to the east. Following that, move south. And then, try to move west. And then, make an effort to head west. And then, go to the west. And then, venture north. After that, make an attempt to go to the north. Then, make an attempt to travel west. After that, attempt to venture south. If you can succeed at that, make an effort to go to the east. If you can finish that, try to head south. If you can get through with that, make an attempt to venture west. Then, venture west. Then, make an attempt to go to the west. And then, pick-up the coin from the floor of the cookery. That's it!
